text.content:
Bulimic characters salve their guilt and insecurity by overindulging in activities that comfort them - in this instance, consuming food (or blood, for vampires). Characters with this affliction will gorge themselves as much as possible when under stress, then purge their systems through drastic means and consume more.

Trigger/Effect: Characters with this derangement must make a Static Conscience/Conviction Challenge when feeding; failure means the vampire feeds until his blood pool is full, whether or not he needs the blood. If forcibly kept from feeding, the vampire must resist frenzy.
